title: Feature-flagged observability tiers + contract gating experiment for premium SLA and compliance pack
creator: Ava Chen
description: Run an experiment that exposes two new observability retention tiers behind feature flags and ties activation of the compliance pack and premium SLA to a lightweight contract/security questionnaire flow. Goal is to validate willingness-to-pay for longer retention and premium SLAs from mid-market/enterprise customers and measure uplift in ARR and support load.
background: Sales and CS report repeated asks for longer observability retention and a clearer contract flow for premium SLAs. Engineering capacity to ship large entitlement work is constrained; a feature-flagged experiment will let us iterate quickly and measure impact before fully productizing as an add-on. Existing experiments have covered retention tiering in other forms but have not combined retention + contract gating + questionnaire-driven validation.
experiment_hypothesis: If we (1) surface a 90-day and 365-day retention tier behind a controlled feature flag, and (2) require a short security questionnaire + contract acknowledgement before enabling the premium SLA, then a measurable subset of trial and commercial accounts will convert at a >2% attach rate and average revenue per attached tenant will exceed current baseline by at least 15% without a disproportionate increase in support tickets.
proposed_approach: Add two new retention tiers in Console: Retention-90d and Retention-365d. Initially hidden behind feature flags 'obs_retention_90' and 'obs_retention_365'.

Introduce a lightweight compliance pack product tile that requires completing a 6-question security questionnaire (hosted in a Rev/Confluence form) and a contract checkbox acceptance. Questionnaire responses are stored in customer metadata (read-only for users).
Premium SLA is an entitlement gated by the same questionnaire + signed contract acknowledgement; operationally map to existing SLA routing and page-of-record for support escalation.
Expose an admin API endpoint for Solutions Engineers to enable the tiers per-tenant while the experiment runs. Feature flags will toggle UI visibility and API enforcement.
Instrument events for conversion funnel: impression -> questionnaire start -> questionnaire complete -> entitlement enable -> first invoice charge for add-on.
Run the experiment for 8 weeks with a 10% randomized sample of eligible commercial tenants (exclude public/free sandbox accounts and customers with active legal holds).
A/B variant: one group sees pricing line-item with trial credit and 'request enable' flow (manual SE enable), the other sees immediate self-serve enable after questionnaire (self-serve).
acceptance_criteria: Retention tiers appear/disappear correctly based on feature flags in Console and API.
Questionnaire form captures responses and surfaces completion status in tenant metadata.
Contract acknowledgement checkbox creates a legal audit trail entry (timestamp, user, tenant id).
Entitlement mapping ties questionnaire completion to premium SLA activation in routing policies.
Instrumentation events emitted and visible in Analytics dashboard for funnel analysis.
SE admin enable endpoint works and is locked to internal roles; telemetry shows no unauthorized calls.
Runbook for reversing enablement and refund path documented and reviewed by Legal and Finance.
Security review completed and any PII concerns addressed (questionnaire data stored encrypted and retention policy defined).
rollout_steps: Week 0: Feature flags implemented behind 'obs_retention_90' and 'obs_retention_365'; admin enable API built; questionnaire prototype hosted in Confluence form.
Week 1: Internal alpha with SE and 3 pilot customers; gather qualitative feedback and fix usability issues.
Week 2: Enable randomized rollout to 10% eligible tenants; split into A/B variants (self-serve vs request-enable).
Weeks 3-7: Monitoring window; weekly metrics review with Eng, PM, Legal, Sales Engineering.
Week 8: Analyze results; recommend productization path (self-serve product, contract templates, pricing adjustments) or rollback.
Contingency: Immediate rollback of self-serve enable if error rate or unauthorized access is detected.
success_metrics: Attach rate to any retention tier >= 2% of targeted sample within 8 weeks.
Average MRR uplift per attached tenant >= 15% vs baseline.
Questionnaire completion rate >= 50% for tenants who start the flow.
No more than 10% increase in monthly support tickets from participating tenants attributable to the enablement.
Time-to-enable (self-serve) median under 5 minutes; request-enable median under 48 hours.
Percent of enabled tenants with signed contract acknowledgement >= 95% when premium SLA enabled.
